items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I worked with him. It was one of those groups... I used him on vibraphones on one date that I did for the Irving Mills thing.

ctx.x: Yeah, I've seen them. I know Harry Carney used to admire a bass sax. Who was it, Adrian Rollini --
He used to talk about a lot, and how much he admired him.
